steps.title: Add magnetic beads to samples
steps.instruction: Mix magnetic beads 5 times, then dispense 50 µL of beads to each sample (one tip per sample) and return the tips after use; repeat for all samples.

steps.title: First mixing and 4‑min incubation
steps.instruction: Mix each sample 5 times with 200 µL, then wait 4 minutes; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Repeat mixing and 4‑min incubation (4×)
steps.instruction: Perform four additional cycles of mixing: mix each sample 5 times with 200 µL, wait 4 minutes, using one tip per sample and returning the tip after each cycle.

steps.title: Final mixing and 10‑min incubation
steps.instruction: Mix each sample 5 times with 200 µL, then wait 10 minutes; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Remove supernatant, keep 180 µL
steps.instruction: Slowly aspirate all liquid from each well leaving exactly 180 µL, based on distance from the bottom of the well, and dispense the removed liquid to waste; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Mix and transfer to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Mix the remaining 180 µL 5 times, then transfer the entire volume to the PCR plate positioned on the magnetic plate; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Place the magnetic plate on the magnet to engage the beads.

steps.title: Aspirate liquid from PCR plate
steps.instruction: Pipette out all liquid (180 µL) from the PCR plate into waste; discard the tips after aspiration.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Release the magnet to disengage the beads.

steps.title: First PBS wash
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL PBS to each well, then mix twice with 100 µL each (2 × 100 µL); use new tips (one per sample) and return the tips after use.

steps.title: Magnet for PBS wash
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet to capture the beads after the PBS wash.

steps.title: Remove PBS wash
steps.instruction: Pipette out 180 µL of PBS from each well into waste; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Release the magnet.

steps.title: Second PBS wash
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL PBS, mix twice with 100 µL each; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Magnet for second wash
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet to capture the beads after the second PBS wash.

steps.title: Remove second PBS
steps.instruction: Pipette out 180 µL of PBS to waste; use one tip per sample and discard the tips after aspiration.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Release the magnet.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer to each well and mix twice with 50 µL each; use one tip per sample and return the tip after use.

steps.title: Add neutralization buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL neutralization buffer (3 ×) to the elution plate using column‑1 tips (8 tips total); discard the tips after use.

steps.title: Magnet for elution
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet to capture the beads after adding buffers.

steps.title: Transfer eluted RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the eluted RNA from the magnetic/PCR plate to the elution plate; use one tip per sample and discard the tips after transfer.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Release the magnet.

steps.title: Add PBS to recover beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL PBS to the PCR plate to recover the beads without touching the well contents; use column‑2 tips (8 tips).

steps.title: Transfer beads to reservoir
steps.instruction: Transfer the used beads to reservoir positions 2‑5 using the same 8 tips as the previous step.
